slot_scores.name: purchase_at_month_start
slot_scores.evidence_quote: For the inventory balance, is the convention that units purchased in a month can be sold in that same month (i.e., ending inventory = beginning inventory + purchases − sales, all within the same month)?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent asked about same-month flow and inventory balance, which is related to purchase timing, but did not explicitly ask whether purchases occur at the beginning of the month before sales.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Purchases occur at the beginning of each month before any sales are made.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never explicitly confirmed the timing of purchases within the month; the user only confirmed that units purchased in a month can be sold in that same month, not that purchases occur at the month start.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while the P1 hidden slot about purchase timing within the month remained unresolved; the related same-month flow question did not fully cover the timing assumption.

summary: The agent asked many useful clarifying questions and resolved most modeling details, but it only partially addressed the timing of purchases within the month and then stopped with that P1 slot unresolved.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
